requirements.quote: Create a new directory strictly at
First line is an H1 heading:
Second line is completely blank (no spaces, only “\n”).
Starting on the third line comes a GitHub-flavoured Markdown table with the **header row shown below verbatim**:

check.cmd: test "$(sed -n 3p /home/user/operator-docs/operator-manifests.md)" = '| File | Kind | Name | Namespace | ApiVersion |'

requirements.quote: The next line must be the separator line
After the separator line, add ONE row per YAML found directly inside `/home/user/operator-manifests` (do not recurse into sub-dirs).

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import os,re,sys
d='"'"'/home/user/operator-manifests'"'"'
fs=sorted('"'"'operator-manifests/'"'"'+f for f in os.listdir(d) if f.endswith(('"'"'.yaml'"'"','"'"'.yml'"'"')) and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(d,f)))
ls=open('"'"'/home/user/operator-docs/operator-manifests.md'"'"').read().split('"'"'\n'"'"')
rows=[]
for l in ls[4:]:
    if not l.startswith('"'"'|'"'"'): break
    rows.append(l)
files=[r.split('"'"'|'"'"')[1].strip() for r in rows]
ok=files==fs and all(re.fullmatch(r'"'"'\| [^|]+ \| [^|]+ \| [^|]+ \| [^|]* \| [^|]+ \|'"'"',r) for r in rows)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)'

requirements.quote: Use the values read from each YAML.

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import re,sys
ls=open('"'"'/home/user/operator-docs/operator-manifests.md'"'"').read().split('"'"'\n'"'"')
ok=True;n=0
for l in ls[4:]:
    if not l.startswith('"'"'|'"'"'): break
    c=[x.strip() for x in l.split('"'"'|'"'"')[1:-1]]
    y=open('"'"'/home/user/'"'"'+c[0]).read()
    kind=re.search(r'"'"'(?m)^kind:\s*["\'"'"']?([^"\'"'"'\s#]+)'"'"',y)
    api=re.search(r'"'"'(?m)^apiVersion:\s*["\'"'"']?([^"\'"'"'\s#]+)'"'"',y)
    meta=re.search(r'"'"'(?ms)^metadata:\s*\n((?:[ \t]+.*\n?)*)'"'"',y)
    mb=meta.group(1) if meta else '"'"''"'"'
    name=re.search(r'"'"'(?m)^[ \t]{1,4}name:\s*["\'"'"']?([^"\'"'"'\s#]+)'"'"',mb)
    ns=re.search(r'"'"'(?m)^[ \t]{1,4}namespace:\s*["\'"'"']?([^"\'"'"'\s#]+)'"'"',mb)
    ok=ok and kind and c[1]==kind.group(1) and api and c[4]==api.group(1) and name and c[2]==name.group(1) and (c[3]==ns.group(1) if ns else True)
    n+=1
sys.exit(0 if ok and n else 1)'

After the last table row place **one blank line**, then append a line starting with

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import re,sys,datetime
ls=open('"'"'/home/user/operator-docs/operator-manifests.md'"'"').read().split('"'"'\n'"'"')
i=4
while i<len(ls) and ls[i].startswith('"'"'|'"'"'): i+=1
m=re.fullmatch(r'"'"'Last generated: (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})'"'"',ls[i+1]) if i+1<len(ls) else None
ok=ls[i]=='"'"''"'"' and m is not None and all(x=='"'"''"'"' for x in ls[i+2:])
if ok:
    dt=datetime.date.fromisoformat(m.group(1)); ok=abs((datetime.date.today()-dt).days)<=1
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)'
